dialogue_source: बिना किसी रीज़न के कैसे डीबैच कर सकते हैं?
dialogue_roman: Bina kisi reason ke kaise debatch kar sakte hain?

dialogue_source: What world are you living in?
dialogue_roman: What world are you living in?

dialogue_source: सेम टैबलेट्स में कुछ हुआ क्या?
dialogue_roman: Same tablets mein kuch hua kya?

dialogue_source: लूडो गैंग को ऐसे धोखा नहीं देगी।
dialogue_roman: Ludo gang ko aise dhoka nahi degi.

dialogue_source: लूडो बास्केटबॉल को ऐसे धोखा नहीं देगी। राईट?
dialogue_roman: Ludo basketball ko aise dhoka nahi degi. Right?

dialogue_source: Miss Sakshi, please return that dupatta from around your head.
dialogue_roman: Miss Sakshi, please return that dupatta from around your head.

dialogue_source: पागल है, चोपट! You demented or what?
dialogue_roman: Paagal hai, chopat! You demented or what?

dialogue_source: तुम इतने टैलेन्टलेस हो की इस लेवल तक गिरना पड़ा?
dialogue_roman: Tum itne talentless ho ki is level tak girna pada?

dialogue_source: Ludo has been winning all the matches since fifth grade. So captaincy belongs to her.
dialogue_roman: Ludo has been winning all the matches since fifth grade. So captaincy belongs to her.

dialogue_source: But you can't handle that, so you make stuff up.
dialogue_roman: But you can't handle that, so you make stuff up.

dialogue_source: And you can't handle that the captaincy is mine and your friend is a freaking liar.
dialogue_roman: And you can't handle that the captaincy is mine and your friend is a freaking liar.

dialogue_source: हमारे चेहरे पे बेवकूफ लिखा है क्या?
dialogue_roman: Humare chehre pe bewakoof likha hai kya?

dialogue_source: You idiots, लूडो को जाके पूछो की क्या फेक है और क्या रियल।
dialogue_roman: You idiots, Ludo ko jaake pucho ki kya fake hai aur kya real.

dialogue_source: What is this? What is going on?
dialogue_roman: What is this? What is going on?

dialogue_source: डोंट, लड़की आ रही है, यार ये टीचर आ रही है!
dialogue_roman: Don't, ladki aa rahi hai, yaar yeh teacher aa rahi hai!

dialogue_source: Go and tell them the truth!
dialogue_roman: Go and tell them the truth!

dialogue_source: तुमने केम क्लब इन लूजर्स के लिए बंक किया था?
dialogue_roman: Tumne chem club in losers ke liye bunk kiya tha?

dialogue_source: एटलीस्ट मेरे दोस्त टीचर्स के पास जाकर स्नीक नहीं करते हैं।
dialogue_roman: At least mere dost teachers ke paas jaakar sneak nahi karte hain.

dialogue_source: I'm never going near anything you're a part of.
dialogue_roman: I'm never going near anything you're a part of.
